e.title: DW Simpson 2026 招聘趋势
e.summary: DW Simpson 2026 精算招聘市场趋势：招聘方视角的年度洞察
e.body: DW Simpson 2026 Market Trends in Actuarial Recruiting：精算招聘市场趋势的年度分析（招聘方视角）——需求/薪资/技能趋势。对 RIAA：精算招聘趋势的权威源（DW Simpson 是 [[dw-simpson-salary-survey]] 的发布者）——与薪酬数据配套：趋势 + 数据；配合 [[asia-actuarial-job-market]]（亚洲市场）对照区域差异；理解 2026 精算岗位的需求方向（AI/数据技能）；求职规划的年度情报。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：DW Simpson 官网确认（2026 招聘趋势文章），未通读
e.summary_en: DW Simpson 2026 market trends in actuarial recruiting: annual recruiter-side insights
e.summary_hk: DW Simpson 2026 精算招聘市場趨勢：招聘方視角的年度洞察
e.body_en: DW Simpson 2026 Market Trends in Actuarial Recruiting: an annual analysis of actuarial recruiting trends (recruiter-side) — demand/salary/skill trends. For RIAA: the authoritative source of actuarial recruiting trends (DW Simpson publishes [[dw-simpson-salary-survey]]) — paired with salary data: trends + data; with [[asia-actuarial-job-market]] (Asia market) contrast regional differences; understand the demand directions of 2026 actuarial roles (AI/data skills); annual intelligence for career planning.
e.body_hk: DW Simpson 2026 Market Trends in Actuarial Recruiting：精算招聘市場趨勢的年度分析（招聘方視角）——需求/薪資/技能趨勢。對 RIAA：精算招聘趨勢的權威源（DW Simpson 是 [[dw-simpson-salary-survey]] 的發佈者）——與薪酬數據配套：趨勢 + 數據；配合 [[asia-actuarial-job-market]]（亞洲市場）對照區域差異；理解 2026 精算崗位的需求方向（AI/數據技能）；求職規劃的年度情報。
